title: Going RV
description:
S05 E06 — RV for Retirement
A couple goes on the lookout for a motor home to take on new adventures and enjoy the perks of retirement; an RV with a bath and a half, plenty of sleeping space and comfortable to drive.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E07 — Bunks For Brothers
A family of four, always on the go in their travel trailer, decide to upgrade to a newer, drivable RV with a bunkhouse for the kids, a roomy kitchen, easy maneuverability and plenty of sleeping space.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E08 — ATV Toy Hauler
A Nevada couple decides to buy an RV that will allow them to set up camp while going on ATV trips with friends; a toy hauler with dry camping capabilities, an open floor plan and an ATV garage.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E09 — Easing Into Camping
A Texas couple wants to spend more quality time with their daughters while easing them into outdoor adventures in an RV; a lightweight, easy-to-tow travel trailer.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E10 — New Priorities, New RV
After a recent health scare, a couple decides to make new priorities that include having fun and making memories while taking family trips in an RV.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E11 — Luxury On Wheels
A fun-loving couple tries to compromise on an RV upgrade that will cater to his rugged camping style and her glamorous camping style.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E12 — Fifth-Wheel For Fifty States
A couple hopes to find the perfect RV that will help them achieve their goal of visiting all 50 states.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E13 — RV For Horse Shows
Caitlin and Sam swap out hotel rooms for a well-equipped RV.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E14 — Bear-Proof RV
Rod and Camille want to provide their young sons with more outdoor adventures, so they are looking for their very first RV to take on camping trips.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E01 — Full-Time RV For Vegas Couple
After a scary four-wheeler accident, a Las Vegas couple reevaluates what they really want in their RV home life; they search for a rig with more room for their granddaughter, plenty of exterior storage space and a bigger kitchen and shower.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E02 — His Toy Hauler or Her Bunkhouse
Kari and her husband, Jose, search for their first travel trailer, hoping to give their young daughter happy camping memories; however, the couple must decide between his toy hauler and her bunkhouse.

description:

Helen and her teenage students convince the principal the younger generation is no different from his own.

description:

Opie and his friend find an abandoned baby and run into trouble when they try to find it some new parents.

description:

title: Happily Ever Emma
description: As an actress, Emma always acts like she's in love for work but knows little of what true love is. When Emma realizes she has always loved her good friend Gray, she learns how love works.

Floyd decides to give up his Mayberry barbershop when Howard Sprague buys the building and raises the rent fifteen dollars a month.

Andy and aunt Bee learn their ancestor is the state's biggest swindler, just before the town of Mayberry unveils his statue as a hero.

Helen writes a children's book that is accepted for publication; Andy faces the disquieting prospect of being the fiancée of a celebrity.

description:

Goober faces disaster when a printing error awards Floyd a large cash prize in his gas station contest.
